name: Rizvan Kuniev
summary: Russian heavyweight (13-3 with a draw and a no-contest in our verified data; outlets list 14-3-1) with elite takedown defence and a punishing clinch. 2-1 in the UFC: a split loss to Curtis Blaydes on debut, a grinding decision over Jailton Almeida, and a third-round knee TKO of Tyrell Fortune.

how_they_fight.Striking: Pressure and clinch work: doubles the jab, straight right at range, but his best weapons are knees (running, jumping and in the clinch), uppercuts and standing elbows (Cageside on Fortune). Also landed a spinning backfist to the body.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defensive wall: stuffed all of Almeida's shots and 13 of 15 Blaydes attempts (Rotowire), reversing on the fence with underhooks. Rarely shoots himself but wins the fence position and holds it.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped in 18 fights. Was taken down early by Blaydes and held on the cage in R1; ate a big right hand and an uppercut from Fortune.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A late finisher who gets better as the fight goes on. Finishes (verified): R1 x4, R2 x1, R3 x4, so nearly half come in the final round. Lost R1 to Blaydes and won the later rounds on the feet; broke Fortune down over two rounds before the R3 finish at 1:12. His decisions can be low-action (Almeida).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient and methodical; picks the clinch and the knee when opponents come forward. Can sit in control and win rounds without much offence.

patterns: Walks opponents to the fence, then knees and uppercuts
Neutralises wrestlers with takedown defence and clinch reversals
concerns: Untested against a long, technical kickboxer like Volkov
Lost his UFC debut on a split decision after giving up R1 to Blaydes' takedown and cage control
keys_to_beat: Keep him at range with kicks and the jab; deny the clinch
Win the early rounds before he settles
Avoid lowering the head on entries (knees)

news.text: Stopped Tyrell Fortune with knees at 1:12 of R3 at UFC Abu Dhabi; Fortune told his corner a knee had hurt his ribs (Cageside).
Booked against Alexander Volkov at UFC 333.
